source_snapshot.procedure: Read/set every OAM PowerLimitWatts.SetPoint through OOB Redfish and verify via amd-smi; separately read/set/reset all GPU caps in-band; run referenced Max Power Test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Either OOB or in-band config succeeds and measured power attains the configured cap under Max Power Test.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL insecure fixed-IP reads only; omits OOB/in-band writes, workload correlation and restoration.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores identity-bound write/cross-plane/workload/thermal evidence and per-device original-cap recovery.

old_problem: Fixed eight-OAM/550 examples lack live OAM-GPU mapping, supported ranges/units, Redfish ETag semantics and compatible amd-smi behavior. The referenced Max Power Test has no supplied workload/thresholds. Bulk writes can leave asymmetric caps, and DeepSeek removes both write paths, physical cap proof and restoration.
disposition_reason: The original coverage is an explicit two-plane state-change test plus workload validation; all parts remain. Live topology, supported cap bounds, chosen value and Max Power Test recipe are runtime Project Configuration under ED-15. Every original cap is captured and each write individually verified before workload; restoration is exact per device, with no blind reset/retry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2055, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2056 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00010-V002 / 97a9929b4752d095 was directly read from XLSX.
A configured SetPoint is not physical enforcement; the same immutable OAM/GPU must align across Redfish SetPoint, amd-smi MAX_POWER/SOCKET_POWER and measured workload power.

OOB and in-band are separate methods and evidence identities; the source's `either` verdict permits an approved primary method but does not allow its write/readback/workload evidence to be replaced by read-only collection.
The value 550 is only an example; the signed platform range/unit and bounded target determine safe execution. Max Power thresholds/duration cannot be invented.
All original per-device values and ETags are captured; partial bulk success stops and restores only known changed devices under control.
No Redfish/amd-smi query or write, power-cap change/reset, Max Power workload, authentication, restoration or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: OOB/in-band GPU power-cap setting, physical enforcement and exact restoration
test_case.purpose: On every approved live OAM/GPU, set a platform-approved bounded power cap through the selected OOB or in-band method, cross-check both management planes, prove physical enforcement under the approved Max Power workload, and restore each original cap exactly.
required_package: Exact row-2055 variant plus SUT/BMC/UBB/OAM/GPU/driver identities and live physical-to-Redfish-to-amd-smi map
Protected EnvironmentMetrics schema/ETag/write semantics and compatible ROCm/amd-smi version/index mapping
Per-device supported range/unit, immutable original cap and approved bounded test cap; 550 is not assumed
Approved OOB and/or in-band method/scope with explicit state-change authorization
Versioned Max Power Test workload, duration, instrumentation, attainment/tolerance and PASS/FAIL rules
Maintenance/no-conflicting-load, thermal/power/GPU aborts and per-device restore/recovery
test_case.test_command: STATE-CHANGING PACKAGE-GATED; preserve logs and collect exact live OAM/GPU/amd-smi mapping, every original Redfish SetPoint/ETag and in-band cap/range. Validate the approved target per device. After explicit authorization, change only named devices through the selected method, one identity at a time, capturing each response/exit and immediate OOB plus in-band readback; stop on partial/asymmetric result. Run the exact approved Max Power Test for its full duration with calibrated per-device power, temperature and GPU-health monitoring, correlate attainment to the configured cap, then restore each recorded original value through the approved plane and verify both planes. No fixed eight/550 assumption, log clear, bulk blind reset or auto-retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every targeted physical OAM/GPU accepts the approved cap within its supported range, OOB and in-band readbacks identify the same value/device, the full Max Power Test demonstrates policy-compliant cap attainment without thermal/power/GPU failure, and every device returns to its exact original cap with consistent cross-plane evidence.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable mapping, original values, authorized per-device writes, cross-plane readback, approved full workload/measurement rules, cap attainment and complete exact restoration. FAIL on mapping/range/ETag/write mismatch, partial/asymmetric state, cap not physically attained, workload/thermal/GPU fault or restore mismatch. Missing target/threshold/workload/approval/recovery is NOT READY; SetPoint alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Treat every PATCH/set/reset and stress run as state-changing; require named devices/value/method and explicit authorization.
Never assume OAM count, indices, 550, units or safe range; validate live physical mapping and original values first.
Monitor power, temperature and GPU health continuously; stop on mapping/write/alarm/cap/workload mismatch.
No log clearing or blind retry/reset. Restore exact recorded per-device values and escalate any restore failure.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and signed OAM/Redfish/amd-smi physical map
Tool/schema/ETag/range/unit identity plus per-device original and approved target caps
Authorization and complete per-device OOB/in-band write/readback outcomes
Full Max Power workload/output and calibrated power/thermal/GPU time series against approved attainment rules
Exact per-device restoration with OOB/in-band verification and partial-state analysis
No-clear/no-retry audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On partial write, wrong identity, workload/thermal/GPU abort or cap mismatch, stop further writes/workload and preserve first raw state. Restore only devices proven changed to their recorded original values through the approved method, verify both planes, and do not use a blanket reset or retry. Isolate and escalate any device whose original cap cannot be proven.

source_conflict.reason: Live identity/range/ETag mapping and a versioned Max Power recipe replace unsafe fixed examples, while both write/readback and physical enforcement/restoration coverage are retained.

blocked.reason: The cap-setting, workload proof, verdict and recovery are complete; topology, tools/ranges/value and Max Power criteria are runtime Project inputs.
